items.raw_excerpt: On a day marking 100 years since the legendary premier was born, another former premier in Mike Rann recalls his own entry to politics under Don Dunstan's leadership.
items.summary_en: Former premier Mike Rann recalled how he entered politics under Don Dunstan. He shared his memory 100 years after Dunstan's birth.
items.summary_ko: 마이크 랜 전 총리는 던스탄의 지도 아래 정치에 입문했던 자신의 경험을 떠올렸다. 던스탄이 태어난 지 100년이 된 날 그는 이 기억을 되살렸다.
items.title_en: Mike Rann remembers Don Dunstan 100 years after his birth
items.title_ko: 던스탄 탄생 100년, 마이크 랜 전 총리의 회상
items.title_original: Mike Rann on 'maestro of the possible' 100 years after Don Dunstan's birth
